# Metrics

<!-- Generated by `npm run gen:sql` from lib/analytics/metrics.ts and messages/en.json. Do not edit by hand. -->

Every number on a dashboard is defined here (spec 12). The **label** and **definition** are what the dashboard
shows in its tooltip; the **formula** and **source** say exactly how it is computed.

Common rules:

- Dates are Indian Standard Time calendar days. A range includes both its first and last day.
- The comparison period has the same number of days and ends the day before the range starts.
- Money is stored in whole paise and shown in rupees with Indian digit grouping. Spend is before TDS and GST.
- A rate or average whose denominator is zero shows “—”, never 0.
- Staff dashboards read summary views refreshed every 15 minutes (the time of the last refresh is shown). A
  creator's own home dashboard reads live data.
- Creators see only their own figures, never Eduwit's revenue, margin or other creators' numbers (except their
  own leaderboard position when they opt in).

## Lead funnel

### Clicks (`clicks`)

Visits through tracking links. Bots and link previews are not counted.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Formula | Clicks on tracking links by click date (IST), excluding crawlers, link previews and HEAD requests |
| Unit | Count |
| Period | In the selected date range |
| Direction | Higher is better |
| Source | `inf.an_clicks_daily` (from `inf.link_clicks`) |

### Leads (`leads`)

Students who enquired through a creator's link or code and were credited to them.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Formula | Credited leads (first touch, plus last touch under the last-touch model) by enquiry date (IST); the same leads a creator sees in their pipeline |
| Unit | Count |
| Period | In the selected date range |
| Direction | Higher is better |
| Source | `inf.an_leads` (from `inf.lead_attributions` and `inf.creator_lead_feed`) |

### Qualified (`qualified_leads`)

Leads that reached the Qualified stage or went further.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Formula | Of those leads, the ones that have reached Qualified or any later stage (stages are cumulative) |
| Unit | Count |
| Period | In the selected date range |
| Direction | Higher is better |
| Source | `inf.an_leads` (from `inf.lead_attributions` and `inf.creator_lead_feed`) |

### Allocated (`allocated_leads`)

Leads handed to an Eduwit counsellor, or further along.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Formula | Of those leads, the ones allocated to a counsellor or further |
| Unit | Count |
| Period | In the selected date range |
| Direction | Higher is better |
| Source | `inf.an_leads` (from `inf.lead_attributions` and `inf.creator_lead_feed`) |

### Applied (`applications`)

Leads that applied to a programme or enrolled.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Formula | Of those leads, the ones that applied or enrolled |
| Unit | Count |
| Period | In the selected date range |
| Direction | Higher is better |
| Source | `inf.an_leads` (from `inf.lead_attributions` and `inf.creator_lead_feed`) |

### Enrolled (`enrollments`)

Leads that enrolled. Refunded or cancelled enrolments are not counted.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Formula | Of those leads, the ones that enrolled (refunded or cancelled enrolments do not count) |
| Unit | Count |
| Period | In the selected date range |
| Direction | Higher is better |
| Source | `inf.an_leads` (from `inf.lead_attributions` and `inf.creator_lead_feed`) |

### Click to lead (`click_to_lead_rate`)

Leads as a share of clicks. It can pass 100% when students type a creator code instead of clicking.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Formula | leads ÷ clicks (can exceed 100% when students type a creator code without clicking) |
| Unit | Percent |
| Period | In the selected date range |
| Direction | Higher is better |
| Source | clicks, leads |

## Lead quality

### Qualification rate (`qualification_rate`)

Share of leads that reached Qualified or further.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Formula | qualified leads ÷ leads |
| Unit | Percent |
| Period | In the selected date range |
| Direction | Higher is better |
| Source | `inf.an_leads` (from `inf.lead_attributions` and `inf.creator_lead_feed`) |

### Junk (`junk_rate`)

Share of leads closed as junk or test enquiries.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Formula | leads closed as junk ÷ leads |
| Unit | Percent |
| Period | In the selected date range |
| Direction | Lower is better |
| Source | `inf.an_leads` (from `inf.lead_attributions` and `inf.creator_lead_feed`) |

### Duplicates (`duplicate_rate`)

Share of enquiries that were not credited because the student had already enquired.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Formula | attributions decided as duplicates ÷ all attribution decisions (credited or not) |
| Unit | Percent |
| Period | In the selected date range |
| Direction | Lower is better |
| Source | `inf.an_leads` (all decisions) |

### Enrolment rate (`enrollment_rate`)

Share of leads that enrolled.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Formula | enrolments ÷ leads |
| Unit | Percent |
| Period | In the selected date range |
| Direction | Higher is better |
| Source | `inf.an_leads` (from `inf.lead_attributions` and `inf.creator_lead_feed`) |

## Spend

### Committed (`committed_spend`)

Fixed fees, milestones, guarantees and extra fees Eduwit has agreed to pay on agreed and active deals, even with no leads.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Formula | For agreed and active deals: the fixed fees, milestones, retainers, minimum guarantees and extra fees the creator earns over the deal's term with no leads at all (the compensation engine's zero-performance simulation), before tax |
| Unit | ₹ (paise stored, rupees shown) |
| Period | Now (ignores the date range) |
| Direction | Neither |
| Source | `inf.deals.committed_paise` (written by the ledger runner) |

### Accrued (`accrued_spend`)

What creators earned in the period, net of penalties and clawbacks, before tax.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Formula | Earnings posted to creator ledgers in the period by posting date: credits minus debits (penalties, clawbacks, reversals), before TDS and GST; settlement lines excluded |
| Unit | ₹ (paise stored, rupees shown) |
| Period | In the selected date range |
| Direction | Neither |
| Source | `inf.an_spend_daily` (from `inf.ledger_entries`) |

### Paid (`paid_spend`)

Payouts sent in the period, before TDS.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Formula | Gross amount of payouts marked paid in the period (by payment date), before TDS |
| Unit | ₹ (paise stored, rupees shown) |
| Period | In the selected date range |
| Direction | Neither |
| Source | `inf.payouts` |

### Budget (`budget`)

The campaign budget.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Formula | The campaign's budget as entered on the campaign |
| Unit | ₹ (paise stored, rupees shown) |
| Period | Now (ignores the date range) |
| Direction | Neither |
| Source | `inf.campaigns.budget_paise` |

### Budget used (`budget_used`)

Accrued spend to date as a share of the campaign budget.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Formula | accrued spend to date on the campaign's deals ÷ budget |
| Unit | Percent |
| Period | To date (ignores the date range) |
| Direction | Neither |
| Source | accrued spend (all time), budget |

## Unit economics

### Revenue (`revenue`)

Eduwit's commission received in the period for enrolments from creator leads, excluding GST.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Formula | Eduwit's commission received in the period for enrolments of credited leads, excluding GST, by the date it was received (or recorded, when the CRM gives no date); partly paid invoices count pro rata |
| Unit | ₹ (paise stored, rupees shown) |
| Period | In the selected date range |
| Direction | Higher is better |
| Source | `inf.an_revenue` (from `inf.receipts_effective()` and `inf.lead_attributions`) |

### Expected revenue (`expected_revenue`)

Eduwit's commission still to be received for enrolments from creator leads, excluding GST.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Formula | Eduwit's commission still expected now (not yet received) for enrolments of credited leads, excluding GST |
| Unit | ₹ (paise stored, rupees shown) |
| Period | Now (ignores the date range) |
| Direction | Higher is better |
| Source | `inf.an_revenue` |

### Cost per lead (`cost_per_lead`)

Accrued spend divided by leads.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Formula | accrued spend ÷ leads |
| Unit | ₹ (paise stored, rupees shown) |
| Period | In the selected date range |
| Direction | Lower is better |
| Source | accrued spend, leads |

### Cost per qualified lead (`cost_per_qualified_lead`)

Accrued spend divided by qualified leads.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Formula | accrued spend ÷ qualified leads |
| Unit | ₹ (paise stored, rupees shown) |
| Period | In the selected date range |
| Direction | Lower is better |
| Source | accrued spend, qualified leads |

### Cost per enrolment (`cost_per_enrollment`)

Accrued spend divided by enrolments.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Formula | accrued spend ÷ enrolments |
| Unit | ₹ (paise stored, rupees shown) |
| Period | In the selected date range |
| Direction | Lower is better |
| Source | accrued spend, enrolments |

### Net ROI (`net_roi`)

Revenue minus accrued spend, as a share of accrued spend.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Formula | (revenue − accrued spend) ÷ accrued spend |
| Unit | Percent |
| Period | In the selected date range |
| Direction | Higher is better |
| Source | revenue, accrued spend |

### ROAS (`roas`)

Revenue for every rupee of accrued spend.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Formula | revenue ÷ accrued spend |
| Unit | Ratio (×) |
| Period | In the selected date range |
| Direction | Higher is better |
| Source | revenue, accrued spend |

## Creator earnings

### Total earned (`earned_total`)

Everything you have earned so far, net of penalties and clawbacks, before tax.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Formula | Everything the creator has earned to date, net of penalties and clawbacks, before tax |
| Unit | ₹ (paise stored, rupees shown) |
| Period | To date (ignores the date range) |
| Direction | Higher is better |
| Source | `inf.ledger_entries` |

### Pending (`earnings_pending`)

Earned, waiting for confirmation (for example until Eduwit receives its commission).

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Formula | Earned but not yet confirmed (for example commission waiting for Eduwit's own commission) |
| Unit | ₹ (paise stored, rupees shown) |
| Period | Now (ignores the date range) |
| Direction | Neither |
| Source | `inf.ledger_entries` |

| Period | Now (ignores the date range) |
| Direction | Neither |
| Source | `inf.ledger_entries` |
